title: NVIDIA board announces independent investigation
summary: The board announced an inquiry after reporting that Huang had been the target of a foreign intelligence effort. Its statement said it had no reason at that time to believe national security or company secrets had been compromised.

title: Independent directors retain outside counsel
summary: NVIDIA's independent directors announced that Joon H. Kim and his firm were retained to conduct the previously announced investigation.

title: NVIDIA announces CEO transition
summary: NVIDIA announced Huang's resignation and named Colette Kress interim CEO and Harvey C. Jones chair of the board.

title: House committees announce transcribed interviews
summary: The House Foreign Affairs Committee said Huang and NVIDIA general counsel Tim Teter agreed to appear for transcribed interviews on 1 and 2 December respectively. The interviews were future plans as of this record's check date.

title: NVIDIA reports fiscal third-quarter results
summary: NVIDIA reported revenue of $115.8 billion for its fiscal third quarter and identified Colette Kress as interim chief executive.
